question: In which of the following months was the Project PARI (Public Art of India) initiated?  (RRB Technician Grade III (26/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: October 2024
August 2024
July 2024
September 2024
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is July 2024

Explanation:
Project PARI (Public Art of India) was initiated in July 2024. It was launched by the Ministry of Culture of the Government of India to promote public art across the country. The project aims to make Indian art and culture accessible to the masses and provide a platform to young artists. Under this initiative, murals, sculptures, and other art installations will be created in various cities. The launch event took place in New Delhi, and the project is also being promoted through digital media. PARI seeks to transform public spaces into vibrant art galleries and encourage community participation.

☛ What types of art are included in PARI? → Murals, sculptures, and art installations

question: In 1987, the UNEP succeeded in forging an agreement to freeze Chlorofluorocarbons production at 1986 levels. What is the full form of UNEP? (RRB Technician Grade III (26/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: United Nations Ecological Programme
United Nations Environment Programme
United Nations Ecological Policy
United Nations Environment Policy
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is United Nations Environment Programme

Explanation:
The full form of UNEP is United Nations Environment Programme. It was established in 1972 after the Stockholm Conference. UNEP is a UN agency that coordinates environmental activities and assists countries in implementing environmentally sound policies. In 1987, UNEP played a key role in forging the Montreal Protocol, which aimed to freeze the production of Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) at 1986 levels. This agreement was a landmark step in protecting the ozone layer. The headquarters of UNEP is located in Nairobi, Kenya.

☛ Where is the headquarters of UNEP? → Nairobi, Kenya
☛ What is the Montreal Protocol related to? → Protection of the ozone layer
☛ When was the Montreal Protocol adopted? → 1987
☛ What is the full form of UNEP? → United Nations Environment Programme

solution_hi:

Explanation:
UNEP का पूरा नाम United Nations Environment Programme है, जिसे हिंदी में संयुक्त राष्ट्र पर्यावरण कार्यक्रम कहा जाता है। इसकी स्थापना 1972 में स्टॉकहोम सम्मेलन के बाद हुई थी। यह संयुक्त राष्ट्र की एक एजेंसी है जो वैश्विक पर्यावरणीय मुद्दों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करती है। 1987 में, UNEP ने मॉन्ट्रियल प्रोटोकॉल को आकार देने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई, जिसने क्लोरोफ्लोरोकार्बन (CFC) के उत्पादन को 1986 के स्तर पर स्थिर करने का प्रावधान किया। यह समझौता ओजोन परत के संरक्षण के लिए एक ऐतिहासिक कदम था। UNEP का मुख्यालय नैरोबी, केन्या में स्थित है।

question: In India, irrigation projects with a Cultivable Command Area (CCA) of more than 10,000 hectares are classified as: (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (05/06/2025) Shift 3)
options: Local Projects
Micro Projects
Minor Projects
Major Projects
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Major Projects

Explanation:
In India, irrigation projects are classified based on Cultivable Command Area (CCA). Projects with a CCA of more than 10,000 hectares are categorized as Major Projects. This classification is defined by the Ministry of Water Resources. Major projects involve large dams, canal networks, and reservoirs. Their construction and maintenance are handled by the central or state government. In contrast, projects with CCA between 2,000 and 10,000 hectares are Medium, and those with less than 2,000 hectares are Minor projects. Major projects aim to provide irrigation facilities on a large scale, covering extensive agricultural areas.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the CCA for Major Irrigation Projects? → More than 10,000 hectares
☛ What is the CCA for Minor Irrigation Projects? → Up to 2,000 hectares
☛ What is the CCA for Medium Irrigation Projects? → 2,000 to 10,000 hectares
☛ Who manages Major Projects? → Central or state government
☛ What is the basis of irrigation classification in India? → Cultivable Command Area (CCA)
question_hi: भारत में, 10,000 हेक्टेयर से अधिक कृषि योग्य कमांड क्षेत्र (CCA) वाली सिंचाई परियोजनाओं को किस रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (05/06/2025) Shift 3)

सूक्ष्म परियोजनाएँ
लघु परियोजनाएँ
प्रमुख परियोजनाएँ
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है प्रमुख परियोजनाएँ

Explanation:
भारत में सिंचाई परियोजनाओं को कृषि योग्य कमांड क्षेत्र (CCA) के आधार पर वर्गीकृत किया जाता है। 10,000 हेक्टेयर से अधिक CCA वाली परियोजनाओं को प्रमुख परियोजनाएँ (Major Projects) कहा जाता है। यह वर्गीकरण जल संसाधन मंत्रालय द्वारा निर्धारित है। प्रमुख परियोजनाओं में बड़े बांध, नहर प्रणाली और जलाशय शामिल होते हैं। इनका निर्माण और रखरखाव केंद्र या राज्य सरकार द्वारा किया जाता है। इसके विपरीत, 2,000 से 10,000 हेक्टेयर CCA वाली परियोजनाएँ मध्यम और 2,000 हेक्टेयर से कम वाली लघु (Minor) श्रेणी में आती हैं। प्रमुख परियोजनाओं का उद्देश्य बड़े पैमाने पर सिंचाई सुविधा प्रदान करना है।

question: The PM-KISAN scheme launched by the Central Government falls under which category of boxes under the WTO’s Agreement on Agriculture? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (23/06/2025) Shift 3)
options: Red box
Amber box
Blue box
Green box
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Green box

Explanation:
The PM-KISAN scheme (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) provides income support of Rs. 6,000 per year to small and marginal farmers. Under the WTO's Agreement on Agriculture, the Green box includes subsidies that do not distort trade or cause minimal distortion. PM-KISAN is an income support program not linked to production or prices, thus it falls under the Green box. Amber box contains production-related subsidies, Blue box includes subsidies with production limits, and Red box refers to prohibited subsidies.

question: Integrated Tribal Development Project (ITDP) comes into existence as a part of the _______ Five-Year Plan. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/02/2021) Shift 2)

question: What is the agenda behind the Government of India's flagship programme ‘Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana’?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (22/02/2021) Shift 2)
